overall_assessment: The modern UiT layout (Om emnet / Hva lærer du / Undervisning og pensum / Eksamen with Obligatoriske arbeidskrav sub-headings) is split well: outcomes are complete, reading lists and arbeidskrav land in the right sections. Recurring weaknesses are the Forkunnskapskrav paragraph left inside course_content (prerequisites never emitted), logistics-only assessment rows, admin noise in teaching_methods, and arbeidskrav text filed under assessment on the 2012-2019 layout. The four 'no sections' suspects are bare 2011 stubs with nothing to extract.

findings.evidence:
Forkunnskapskrav

Jf. opptakskrav og progresjonskrav i studieplanen for grunnskolelærerutdanning 1.-7 trinn og 5.-10. trinn, eller jf. opptakskrav for master i fagdidaktikk.
findings.description: In the 2023+ layout 'Forkunnskapskrav' is a paragraph-level heading inside 'Om emnet'. It is not read as a heading, so the label and its text stay in course_content and no prerequisites section is emitted (pre-pass flag leak->prerequisites is real in LER-3211 x2, LER-1123, LER-1104, LER-3101 x2). Much of the text is a cross-reference to admission requirements, but it is the plan's prerequisite statement and the label is mis-filed as content.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The heading map already maps 'forkunnskapskrav' to prerequisites, but the uit reader (section_* config) only picks up h2 headings, so this in-body label never reaches sectionize().
findings.suggested_fix: Add a line-start split for 'Forkunnskapskrav' within the Om emnet block for uit (or let the reader treat that label as a sub-heading) so the paragraph goes to prerequisites and the trailing 'Emnet inneholder følgende tema...' stays in course_content (note the content paragraph follows the prerequisite paragraph, so cut after the first paragraph).

findings.description: The 'Opptakskrav' block is dropped wholesale. Some of it is genuine prerequisite content, not Studentweb boilerplate: 'forkunnskapskravet fullført lærerutdanning med minimum 60 studiepoeng i matematikk' (LER-3211), 'Studenten må ha bestått praksis fra forrige studieår' (LRU-1271). That information is lost for the prerequisites analysis.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/section_heading_map.R maps 'opptakskrav' to .drop (#211) on the assumption that it is admission boilerplate; at uit the block carries concrete requirements.
findings.suggested_fix: For uit, map 'Opptakskrav' to prerequisites when the text names a course/credit/previous-year requirement, or drop only when it is pure application text ('Lokalt opptak gjennom søknadsweb', as in FYS-0001). Needs a decision; low-risk variant: institution-specific override in R/institution_config.R.

findings.evidence: Skriftlig skoleeksamen	Dato:   Varighet: 6 Timer	Karakterregel:A–E, stryk F
findings.description: For the Norwegian-teacher-education courses the whole assessment section is the 85-char 'Eksamener' logistics table (empty 'Dato:' field, duration, grading rule). It states the exam form and length but nothing else, and is identical in about 25 courses (pre-pass 'boilerplate' flag is real). It is exam-logistics rather than a description of the assessment.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The Eksamener table is the only content under the 'Eksamen' heading; the real assessment description is not on the page for these plans. The extractor emits the table verbatim, including the empty 'Dato:' label.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the exam form and duration but strip empty 'Dato:' fields and 'Karakterregel:' tails in .clean_sections() for uit, or mark the row as table-only so downstream can treat it as structured data.

findings.evidence: Studenten er forpliktet til å fylle ut og levere inn Institutt for lærerutdanning og pedagogikks vurderingsskjema av praksis innen oppgitt tidsfrist. Ikke innlevert skjema medfører at praksis ikke kan godkjennes.
findings.description: Under the 2012-2019 layout the 'Arbeidskrav' block sits under 'Eksamen'. In LRU-1271 only the first paragraph (fravær) reaches coursework_requirements; the second paragraph, which is also a pass/approve gate, lands in assessment (codebook: arbeidskrav belong in coursework_requirements). Elsewhere in the packet the split works (LRU-1502, LRU-3904, LRU-1127, NOR-3115), so this is a split-in-the-middle case.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The standalone 'Arbeidskrav' line is treated as a block start but the block ends at the first blank line/paragraph; following paragraphs fall back into assessment.
findings.suggested_fix: In the uit Eksamen block, extend the arbeidskrav chunk until the next line-start 'Eksamen og vurdering' / 'Eksamen består av' instead of ending at the first paragraph break.

findings.evidence:
Kvalitetssikring
Emnet evalueres i henhold til instituttets retningslinjer.
Praksis
For nærmere informasjon om praksis, se egen praksisplan.
findings.description: teaching_methods carries course-evaluation (Kvalitetssikring), practice cross-references and the unmapped sub-section 'Undervisnings- og eksamensspråk' with its language statement. This is admin noise inside otherwise-correct teaching text (pre-pass boilerplate flag on LRU-1502 is real but low impact). Seen in 14 of 15 courses with a teaching section.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Kvalitetssikring', 'Praksis' (h3-level in the page) and 'Undervisnings- og eksamensspråk' are unmapped, so their text is appended to the preceding section.
findings.suggested_fix: Map 'Kvalitetssikring (av emnet)' and 'Undervisnings- og eksamensspråk' to .drop in R/section_heading_map.R, and strip the sentence 'For nærmere informasjon om praksis, se egen praksisplan.' via .clean_sections().

findings.evidence: Du kan se og få tilgang til deler av pensum via Leganto.
findings.description: From 2023 the reading list is hosted in Leganto and the page only says so plus a 'Pensumliste for <course>' title. The reading_list row contains no titles, only a pointer; it looks like a reading list but is empty of content.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The page really has no reading list; the pointer text is emitted as a row.
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'Du kan se og få tilgang til deler av pensum via Leganto' and '^Pensumliste for ' to the boilerplate-strip list so such rows become empty and are not emitted (or flagged as pointer-only).

findings.description: reading_list is the placeholder 'Se hjemmeside.' (14 chars); the pre-pass 'empty' flag is real. Similar short placeholders in master-thesis plans ('Det er ikke pensum knyttet til mastergradsoppgaven.') are informative and not a problem.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: No placeholder filter for pointer-only values in .clean_sections().
findings.suggested_fix: Add '^se hjemmeside\.?$' (and similar 'Se emnets hjemmeside') to the placeholder patterns so the row is not emitted.

findings.evidence:
Deltakelse undervisning	Karakterregel:
Godkjent – ikke godkjent
findings.description: coursework_requirements contains the table rows 'X Karakterregel: / Godkjent – ikke godkjent' for every arbeidskrav, and in plans with a 'Mer info om arbeidskrav' sub-heading the same arbeidskrav appear twice (table names then detailed bullets, e.g. LER-1104 946 chars). The content is correct and complete, but repetitive and noisy.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Both 'Obligatoriske arbeidskrav' and 'Mer info om arbeidskrav' map to coursework_requirements and are concatenated, with the table markup kept.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() remove '\tKarakterregel:' tails and standalone 'Godkjent – ikke godkjent' lines for coursework_requirements.

findings.description:
The four 'no sections extracted' suspects are false alarms: the plans are bare metadata stubs (code, title, credits, 'Emnet administreres av', 'Lectures'/'Kontakt veileder') with no course content, outcomes or assessment, so there is nothing for the extractor to miss. SPA-3993 and SAM-3940 additionally contain an unclosed '
' fragment in the plan text, harmless here since the section is dropped.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The source pages for these 2010-2011 PPU/lærerutdanning courses are genuinely empty.
findings.suggested_fix: No extractor change; optionally exclude plans whose full text is under ~300 chars from section-level analysis so they are not counted as extraction failures.
